note: H203: sorted(live_set) -- removing process-hash order from a published commitment.

controls.name: C1_hashes_moved_vs_HEAD
controls.must_fire_because: sorting reorders the stream, so the published hashes MUST move -- if none moved, the fix did not reach the code path and F1's stability is the OLD stability
controls.can_fail_because: an edit that never executes leaves every hash byte-identical to HEAD

controls.name: C2_invariants_were_found
controls.must_fire_because: F2 is vacuous if no invariant field was located in the artifacts
controls.can_fail_because: a wrong INVARIANTS name list yields an empty set and a green F2 that checked nothing
controls.null_must_contain: a spike with zero invariants checked

controls.name: C3_wallclock_term_not_at_its_threshold
controls.must_fire_because: F2's only firing invariant is W9's falsifier, whose disjunction contains `median_latency_us > 500.0`. If today's median sat near 500 the flip could not be attributed to load rather than to this fix
controls.can_fail_because: a median within ~20% of 500 us would leave the attribution undecided and this control would refuse to license it
controls.null_must_contain: a median latency close to the 500 us threshold

falsifiers.name: F1_still_hashseed_dependent
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any 64-hex value differs between PYTHONHASHSEED=1 and PYTHONHASHSEED=2
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a hash differing across two hash seeds
falsifiers.refutes: that the sorted() fix removes process dependence
falsifiers.fires_when: any 64-hex value differs between PYTHONHASHSEED=1 and PYTHONHASHSEED=2
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_benchmark_changed
falsifiers.can_fail_because: an invariant (honest_all_passed, mutations rejected, event/record counts) differs from HEAD
falsifiers.refutes: that the fix only reorders and does not alter what the benchmark concludes
falsifiers.fires_when: an invariant (honest_all_passed, mutations rejected, event/record counts) differs from HEAD

falsifier: a hash still differs across hash seeds, or a benchmark invariant moved
